integrity_statement: The claimed all-odd cutoff transition, exact sharp frame bounds, square-root splitting and long-duration threshold are proved analytically. Finite numerical tests are only supplementary. Earlier even-length, length-three and weak-damping results are credited and not claimed anew.
scientific_limitations: Odd integer cutoff lengths at least five and positive damping on the unit critical Gabor lattice only. The exact interior frequency is specified by a unique polynomial root rather than radicals. Literature-equivalent filter-bank versions remain a historical priority risk.
title: One sharp Zak-minimizer transition for every odd finite exponential Gabor cutoff
